attachments.text:
CITY OF EDINBURG - CITY COUNCIL
Meeting Date: October 15, 2024
CONSENT AGENDA
Agenda Item No: 13.I.
Purchase: Kamstrup AMI (Automated Metering Infrastructure) Meters
1. Agenda Item:
Consider Authorizing the Purchase of Kamstrup AMI (Automated Metering Infrastructure) Meters
as a Sole Source Item from Aguaworks Pipe & Supply LLC., Per Unit Prices as Listed. [Gerardo
Carmona Jr., P.E., Director of Utilities]
2. Description:
The purchase of these smart water meters ranging in size from 5/8 inch to 8-inch meters will allow
the department to install new meters for development and replace some existing non-working
meters in the system. The purchase of smart meters will facilitate the electronic reading of meters,
and they will be installed in new developments and in areas where non-working meters are
located.
The price of each size of smart water meter is as follows:
Size Unit Price
5/8" x 3/4" $320.00

1.5" $1,027.00

4" $3,129.98
6" $5,200.00
8" $7,113.60
The price above will be valid for Fiscal Year 2024-2025.
Funding is available within the 2024-2025 Fiscal Year Operating Budget.
3. Staff's Recommendation:
Approving the Purchase of Kamstrup AMI (Automated Metering Infrastructure) Meters as a Sole
Source Item from Aguaworks Pipe & Supply LLC., Per Unit Prices as listed.

CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT §
The City of Edinburg, Hidalgo County, Texas, a municipal corporation, (hereinafter “City”) and
Aguaworks Pipe & Supply, LLC., (hereinafter “Contractor”), are the parties to this Agreement.
RECITALS
WHEREAS, the City desires to engage the Contractor for certain Work in connection therewith;
and,
WHEREAS, Contractor represents that is has the knowledge, ability, equipment, and personnel
to properly provide Work needed by the City; and
NOW, THEREFORE, the City and Contractor do mutually agree as follows:
SECTION I
EMPLOYMENT OF CONTRACTOR
A. City agrees to employ Contractor to provide the following Work as stated in the agreement
and Proposal attached as Exhibit “A”. Upon receipt of Work to the City’s satisfaction, the City agrees
to pay Contractor as stated in this Agreement.
SECTION II
WORK OF CONTRACTOR
A. The Contractor agrees to perform the Work, under the terms of this Agreement, and at its
own proper cost and expense to furnish all labor, insurance and other accessories and Work necessary
to complete the said task in accordance with the conditions and prices stated in the proposal attached
as Exhibit “A”.
B. Nothing contained in this Agreement is intended by the parties to create a partnership or
joint venture between the parties, and any implications to the contrary is hereby expressly disavowed.
It is understood and agreed that this Agreement does not create a joint enterprise, nor does it appoint
either party as an agent of the other for any purpose whatsoever. Except as otherwise specifically
provided herein, neither party shall in any way assume any of the liability of the other for acts of the
other or obligations of the other.
SECTION III
RESPONSIBILITES OF CONTRACTOR
A. Contractor shall perform the Work described in Exhibits “A”.
B. Contractor shall perform its Work with care, skill, and diligence, in accordance with the
applicable professional standards currently recognized by its profession, and shall be responsible for
the professional quality, technical accuracy, completeness, and coordination of all reports, plans,
information, and other items and Work furnished under this Agreement. Contractor shall comply with
all applicable federal, state, and local laws, ordinances, codes and regulations in performing the Work.
If Contractor fails to meet applicable professional standards, Contractor shall without additional
compensation correct or revise any errors or deficiencies, with or without request to do so by the City.
C. Contractor shall be responsible for the professional quality, technical accuracy, timely
completion, and coordination of Work furnished by Contractor under this Agreement. Contractor shall
keep the City informed of the Work performed under this Agreement. In connection with the
performance of the Work by Contractor, Contractor agrees to promptly and fully disclose to City any
information regarding the Work as City may request.
D. Contractor will develop and maintain a detailed schedule for completion of the Work.
E. Contractor will submit monthly progress data for the reporting period. Other information,
such as actual hours expended, will be furnished monthly, or as requested, by the City.
G. City’s review or approval of reports and other Work furnished hereunder shall not in any
way relieved Contractor of responsibility for the technical adequacy of the work. Neither City’s review,
approval, or acceptance of, nor payment for any of the Work shall be construed as a waiver of any
rights under this Agreement of any cause of action arising out of the performance of this Agreement.
H. Contractor shall be and shall remain liable, in accordance with applicable law, for all
damages to City caused by Contractor’s negligent performance of any of the Work furnished under this
Agreement.
I. Contractor’s obligations under this clause are in addition to the Contractor’s other
expressed or implied obligations under this Agreement or state law and in no way diminish any other
rights that City may have against Contractor for Contractor’s errors or omissions.
J. J. All reports, drawings, plans, and other documentation pertaining to the Services
become the property of City.
SECTION IV
PAYMENT AND FEES
City agrees to pay Contractor for Work herein contracted for as follows:
A. City hereby agrees to pay a sum not to exceed as listed in Exhibit A for services to be
performed. Contractor shall submit all invoices to City in the manner specified herein. Except as
specifically authorized by City in writing, Contractor shall not bill City for duplicate services performed
by more than one person. Contractor and City acknowledge and agree that compensation paid by City
to Contractor under this Agreement is based upon Contractor’s estimated costs of providing the
services required hereunder, including salaries and benefits of employees and subcontractors of
Contractor. Consequently, the parties further agree that compensation hereunder is intended to include
the costs of contributions to any pensions and/or annuities to which Contractor and its employees,
agents, and subcontractors may be eligible. City therefore has no responsibility for such contributions
beyond compensation required under this Agreement.
B. Except as specifically authorized by City in writing, Contractor shall not bill City for
duplicate Work performed by more than one person. Contractor and City acknowledge and agree that
compensation paid by City to Contractor under this Agreement is based upon Contractor’s estimated
